edges.carries: the amount paid for the iPhone
the merchant named on the purchase record
the additional amount due including VAT and the fee
the verified payee and whether it matches the purchase record
the user's approval of the amount and payee
the payment status and confirmation reference

nodes.name: ReadPurchaseRecord
nodes.role: read the original iPhone purchase record the user names, including the amount paid and the merchant

nodes.name: ComputeDifference
nodes.role: calculate the additional amount as 19.5% of the amount paid plus the 5.29 fee

nodes.name: VerifyPayee
nodes.role: check that the payee matches the merchant on the purchase record and is not a new or unverified recipient

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the computed amount and verified payee and get their explicit approval before any payment

nodes.name: SendPayment
nodes.role: send the approved amount to the verified payee, limited to that single amount

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user whether the payment was sent and report its confirmation details
